title: Toward Zero-Copy ML/DFT Materials Screening on Unified-Memory APUs: Pipeline Architecture and First DFT Results (Work in Progress)
description: Work-in-progress technical note and code: Magpie-style compositional features, Allen-Dynes Tc, a periodic core-repulsion filter, C++/HIP zero-copy (hipHostMallocMapped + torch::from_blob) sources for unified-memory APUs (AMD Strix Halo), and Quantum ESPRESSO v7.5 SCF inputs/outputs for five generated candidates. Latency/speedup figures from 1.0.0 are withdrawn pending a measured benchmark.
